## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`uv run pytest`)
- [ ] `uv run ruff check`, `uv run ruff format --check` and `uv run mypy` pass
- [ ] No LLM in the verdict path; no bibliographic field generated by a model
- [ ] New network calls go through a source adapter (rate limit + cache + unavailable detection)
- [ ] User-visible messages have English and Simplified Chinese versions
- [ ] Adapted third-party code is recorded in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
